verdict.rationale: Better Stack's marketing claims it plugs into Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix and cloud providers. It also documents escalation rules based on time, team availability, incident origin, and catalog metadata, plus routing incidents to the right responder. However, the ingestion claim comes only from a status-page marketing line, with no per-source integration docs, and condition-based team routing appears only in marketing copy. missing for 10: documented per-source alert ingestion setup (e.g. Datadog/Prometheus integration docs), detailed docs on defining routing conditions to specific teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, alerts from my monitoring tools are ingested through documented sources and routed to the right team by conditions I define

citations.quote: Plug in the services you already use including Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, Azure, AWS & Google Cloud.
Configure complex rules for escalating incidents based on time, team availability, and incident origin.
Route the incident to the right responder.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
